title: Link Visit with Vet
subtitle: A visit now records the vet that attended it — reimplemented unguided, and reviewed by the agent that wrote it.

pr.title: Link Visit with Vet (#37), reimplemented unguided by Opus

bullets: The three piles on the Review tab were not written here. They are review-points.md, committed with the fixes in ce56d912 and parsed off the branch — so what was accepted, declined and assumed arrives in the pull request's own file list.
No build proved this commit: AGENTS.md layout failed for 753f724c and the CI workflow was skipped. The gate was passed over deliberately; nothing on this page rests on a green run.
One commit landed after the agent finished, and it is not a generated file — the red band at the top of the Review tab names it.

Two tabs carry a reason instead of evidence, and both reasons are about this machine rather than about the branch: the traced suite never ran (Sequence) and neither of the two builds the design-system audit compares was up (UX).

sections.title: The concepts, as the team drew them
sections.body:
Conceptual Modelpetclinic-backend/docs/ConceptualModel.drawio.png

Hand-drawn in draw.io and patched from the generated domain model, so the concepts below are the code's, laid out by a person.

{{drawio:conceptual}}

The audit is built around an absence: it reads which roles the design system covers off the components themselves, then looks for native controls filling one of those roles outside any DS host. Labelling what is already right proves nothing — the defect is the bare <select> somebody copied from an older template. Both builds are started by the run itself, this branch against the merge-base, and every screen in the catalogue is shot; only the ones whose DOM differs get a viewer.

blocks.title: Open review issues
blocks.body: Findings the agent read and said no to, with its reason. These are closed decisions, not a queue: your job here is to agree or disagree, and the last three were raised by the agent against itself rather than by a pass.

blocks.title: Auto-fixed
blocks.body: Read off review-points.md, committed with the fixes. Each one names the reviewer that raised it and shows the diff against a8cd9973, the implementation commit — so what the review changed is separable from what the feature changed.

blocks.title: Implementation assumptions
blocks.body: Where the ticket was ambiguous, the reading that was taken — and under Read the other way, the reading that was not. Nothing here is a defect, and nothing here is in the diff: it is the only pile no pass, script or reviewer could reconstruct afterwards.
